notes.title: Announced DLC: Prisoner - The Mystery Complex
notes.content:
I'm glad to present first big DLC: Prisoner - The Mystery Complex!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/741380/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29513357/4e5405cc965d2c5aaad5c8310a04de6a4bf50b33.jpg[/img][/url]

In endless attempts to find a way out, the character accidentally activates additional systems of Complex. Now, he will have to face new traps and trials.
The DLC includes a lot of new content.

Features:

[h1]New stage - Outer Complex[/h1]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29513357/6e675037d504e880fa7b95931ac139be193b4ef3.png[/img]

Find the Complex control room and activate external systems to gain access to the new stage. Each level contains lots of new traps, from lightnings to x-rays.

---

[h1]New game mode - Endless Complex[/h1]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29513357/79d0e4098800f1789b32a5d0e84100eb4fc22b67.png[/img]

Practice your skills and pass as many rooms as possible in the Endless Complex mode. For every 25 rooms you will receive a reward, and the traps will become even stronger.

---

[h1]New game mechanic - Mystery Mechanism[/h1]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29513357/c21e7f2070b33ace769f646330bfadbcb87940a1.png[/img]

Now you can find mechanisms, that will randomly give you either positive or negative effect on a random amount of levels. Activate them at your own risk.

---

[h1]Character skins[/h1]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29513357/64b1e25022322b033b750d022694f2bea98d0697.png[/img]

Unlock additional character skins for passing the trials and levels. The harder the trial, the better the reward.

---

[list]
	[*] New levels
	[*] New traps
	[*] Achievements
[/list]

Prisoner - The Mystery Complex will be available November 8, 2017

notes.title: Prisoner - Pre-release Build #46875
notes.content:
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Added short training at first game launch
	[*]Added color correction to all levels
	[*]Changed sign of player death
	[*]Default jump mode changed to "Low jump"
	[*]Changed some teleports positions
[/list]
[h1]Traps[/h1]
[list]
	[*][b]Steel[/b]

		[*]Bear trap: timing reduced from 0,33 to 0,125 sec
		[*]Fan (1 blade): timing increased from 0,66 to 0,75 sec
	
	[*][b]Electro[/b]

		[*]Single lightning: timing increased from 0,5 to 0,66 sec
		[*]Electric pillars: timing increased from 0,5 to 0,66 sec
		[*]Wandering lightning: timing increased from 0,8 to 1,16 sec
		[*]Electric sphere: timing increased from 0,8 to 1,16 sec
		[*]Lightning wall: timing increased from 0,5 to 0,8
	
	[*][b]Tech[/b]

		[*]Energy crystal: timing increased from 0,58 to 0,66
		[*]Energy cores: timing increased from 0,33 to 0,5
		[*]Transmitter: timing increased from 0,5 to 0,66
		[*]Scanner: timing increased from 1,5 to 2 sec
[/list]
[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Fixed rare bug with Steam API
[/list]
